d:
Gratitude
For the mornings where I wake up and nothing hurts, and for the ones where everything does.
Both of them are teachers.
For my children, who show me every day what presence actually means.
For the love I get to give and the love that finds its way back.
I used to think gratitude is something you feel when things go well. It isn't. It's a practice. Some days it comes easy & some days I have to search for it, and the searching is the practice.
Grateful for the breath. Grateful for the sound. Grateful for existence itself, exactly as it is.
Sending big love your way
